approvedMotherMessage: 可用，设置攻击方式，豆包管线生成视频
sizeContract: Both elites use minerZombie standing body 139.515234375px; exclude weapons/candles; preserve authored action trajectory.

attacks.name: 缝面刽子手
attacks.implementationTarget: melee-attack-resolver.js plus one self-managed contact event
attacks.motion: Single downward cleaver chop, anticipation -> contact -> recovery. Candidate v01 contains a small step and knee/torso follow-through; preserve the accepted authored trajectory and do not add an independent code dash.
attacks.targeting: Lock primary target and direction at action start; rebase origin only, no retargeting or turn tracking.

timingProposal.note: Implemented from approved source f56 and fixed video camera calibration; output frame timing is authoritative in enemy-config textures.frameLayouts.attack.

attacks.counterplay: Visible windup, rear/side dodge, leave contact rectangle or break line of sight; one target and one damage event.

attacks.name: 蜡面哀祷者
attacks.implementationTarget: independent release event and one ground-circle effect, not basic melee range
attacks.motion: Lift supported wax bowl, gather casting hand, extend palm once, recover; no baked spell effect in character video.
attacks.targeting: Lock target/direction at start; at the observed release frame snapshot its valid ground position, then show a fixed warning circle with no subsequent tracking.

rangeProposal.note: Implemented in ground units; fixed warning ellipse rx72/ry36 uses the same hit shape plus target Collider overlap; user runtime tuning pending.

attacks.counterplay: Step out of the marked circle during 900ms warning; walls and different ground surfaces gate cast and impact.
attacks.lifecycle: Interrupt/death cancels any unreleased cast. A released wax seal has its own lifetime and at most one detonation.
noExtras: No spell particles baked into body

scope: Both elites implemented; authoritative final clocks and layouts are in their sprite manifests and matching data/public enemy configs.
sourceToRuntime: Final sprite frame durations are authoritative. Source MP4/GIF retain original timing; final GIF uses the game action timeline.
validation: No tests, game, browser game checks or builds.
